target.question: Has a doctor or other health professional ever told you that you had coronary heart disease?
target.codes: 1 = Yes, 2 = No, 7 = Refused, 9 = Don't know, blank = missing
target.note: This is self-reported, physician-diagnosed CHD. It is not angiography-confirmed disease and it is not a clinical gold standard.

excluded_variables.mcq160c_raw: This is the source of the outcome. Keeping it would be circular.
excluded_variables.age_told_chd: MCQ180C asks at what age the participant was told they had CHD. It is only recorded for people who answered yes, so it is a direct restatement of the label. It is also absent from the 2017-2018 file.
excluded_variables.angina: Angina is asked in the same MCQ160 series, in the same interview, and in clinical terms angina is a presentation of coronary disease rather than a separate risk factor. A model using it would mostly be predicting one self-report from a neighbouring self-report.
excluded_variables.heart_attack: Myocardial infarction is part of coronary heart disease. Someone reporting a heart attack has, by definition, coronary disease, so this is close to a second label rather than a predictor.
excluded_variables.chf: Heart failure is frequently a consequence of coronary disease and is asked in the same block. It is kept for the sensitivity model but not used in the main one.
excluded_variables.stroke: Stroke is a different event from CHD, so this is a weaker case than angina or MI. It is still excluded from the main model for consistency: the whole MCQ160 cardiovascular block is treated the same way, and its effect is quantified in the sensitivity model.
excluded_variables.wt_int: Sample weights describe the sampling design, not the participant. They are kept aside for the weighted descriptive estimates.
excluded_variables.psu: Masked variance unit, meaningless as a predictor.
excluded_variables.stratum: Masked variance stratum, meaningless as a predictor.
excluded_variables.sddsrvyr: The cycle number is kept as a grouping variable for the temporal checks, but a model should not learn from which survey round a person happened to be sampled in.
excluded_variables.exam_status: Used to define the cohort, so it is constant after selection.
excluded_variables.seqn: Sequence number carries no information about the person.
excluded_variables.asthma_still: observed for only 14.7% of the cohort, which is too sparse to be useful

imputation.sensitivity: mean imputation compared in the robustness script

split.rule: cycles treated as exchangeable when the prevalence difference is small or not significant and no predictor is missing in a whole cycle; the cycle-based evaluation is then kept as a robustness check instead of the main design

metrics.threshold_rule: Youden J on cross-validated development predictions
